Audience context, purpose, language, three-slide content and clean-diagram direction are supplied. The source says the copy is fixed.

# Sample slide image prompt
Create exactly one complete 16:9 PowerPoint slide image.
Backend contract: scripts/image_gen.py, gpt-image-2, --size 2560x1440, --quality medium.
Audience: Internal technical colleagues
Deck purpose: Decide what to investigate next in an internal technical discussion.
Language: English
Slide: 2
Role: concept explanation
Intent: Show exactly the supplied account-to-provider relationship.

## Visible text
Title (exact): A shared account
Visible copy (exact): One account across providers
Those are the only two text items allowed in the image.
Do not add diagram labels, subtitles, questions or captions.
Do not render the supplied notes or internal planning points.

## Visual system
White background, dark navy text, teal accent; aligned diagrams; generous whitespace; crisp sans-serif typography; thin connectors; no decorative texture.
Large readable sans-serif headings, sentence-case labels
One main relationship per page, sparse visible text
Stable palette and typography; composition varies by slide role

## Composition
One central account icon connected to several unlabelled provider boxes. Visual grouping and connectors show the relationship; no invented provider names, labels or benefit claims.

## Constraints
- Render English text exactly and legibly.
- Keep title and visible copy well inside the canvas.
- No page number, watermark, unrelated logo, numeric score or invented evidence.
- The complete slide must come from the selected image backend; no local drawing or compositing.
- Do not render speaker notes.
- Supplied title and visible-copy spelling, case and wording are fixed.
- Diagrams may show relationships through icons/connectors but add no visible labels.
- The spoken notes stay separately available with exact wording and paragraph breaks.
